SCREEN: rounded rectangle, offset LEFT, ~330 wide x 315 tall (about 62% of front width, 84% of height), CRT-curved with soft purple inner vignette/glow around the edges over a warm beige-peach center (#d8bca4 center, #b090a0 edges). Face = two short black vertical bars (~10px wide x 50px tall, ~190px apart) placed slightly below screen center; no mouth. RIGHT CONTROL COLUMN (~60px wide strip right of screen): top = round silver knob (~55px dia) with a ridged/notched rim and a raised diagonal bar across its face; below it a second identical round silver knob with a horizontal bar; below that a tall rounded-rectangle silver grille (~55 x 145px) with ~11 horizontal black slats. ANTENNA: silver/white half-sphere dome (~110px wide, ~40px tall) centered on top of the TV; two thin silver rods sprout from the dome in a V, each angled ~35-40 deg from vertical, length ~150px (~0.28 of TV width), each ending in a small white ball tip. PLUG CABLE: thin white/light-grey cord exits the bottom-left underside of the TV (left rear corner), drops vertically past the neck, then curves over the character's left shoulder (viewer's left) and hangs down onto the chest ending in a white two-prong plug pointing downward.
